overview.description: Siwweschr M Eifel Poker is the same regional game family as Siwweschroom: a Toepen-style, no-trump last-trick game where knocks raise risk and players are eliminated after seven points.
overview.deck: 32-card French pack (10, 9, 8, 7, A, K, Q, J in each suit)

history.origins: The Eifel variant (Siwweschroom, Schröömen, Eifelpoker, Tuppen) is documented as a West German regional form of Toepen: same 32-card deal and last-trick aim, with seven-point elimination and no tens-or-jacks announcing.
timeline: Traditional period: Regional Toepen variants establish in western German communities.
Web era: Siwweschroom and related spellings are indexed under the last-trick Toepen variant group.
Present: Played socially under local naming conventions.
history.evolution: The nickname 'Eifelpoker' reflects the bluff-heavy stake pressure from knocking, not poker hand rankings.
history.cultural: Often played in social settings with verbal pressure and table reads shaping fold decisions.

setup.deck: 32 cards, no trumps; suit rank 10 high down to J low.
setup.equipment: Cards and a visible penalty-point tracker.
setup.dealing: Four cards per player; leader is left of dealer.

rules.objective: Survive elimination by minimizing penalty points while contesting the last trick under knock pressure.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal 4 cards each. 2. Play 4 tricks with follow-suit obligation. 3. Highest of led suit wins each trick and leads next. 4. Knocks can happen once players have viewed hands, increasing stake by one each time. 5. Players may fold to avoid deeper loss. 6. Last-trick winner avoids penalty; others lose based on current stake. 7. At 7 points a player is out; last player remaining wins.
keyRules: Only trick four determines hand winner.
Folding accepts current penalty and exits the hand.
Game continues until one player remains.

strategy.basic: Prioritize end-position strength over early-trick vanity wins.
strategy.intermediate: Use folds to cap losses when your line to trick four is weak.
strategy.advanced: Attack with knocks when opponents are pot-committed and suit distributions favor your final-trick control.
tips: Keep track of which high cards in each suit are already spent.
At six points, treat every extra knock as existential risk.

customActions.description: Increase the stake by one; other players may stay in or fold. The last player to knock may not knock again until someone else has knocked.
customActions.constraints: Allowed at any time after players have seen their cards; not allowed on your own knock.

customActions.description: Assign penalty points: players who stayed in but did not win the last trick lose one plus the number of knocks; players who folded lose the stake at fold time.
customActions.constraints: System applies after the last trick is complete.

customActions.description: Remove from the game any player who has reached seven penalty points; the last player remaining wins.
customActions.constraints: System applies after penalties; players at seven points are out.

prompts.human: Play for survival: four tricks, no trumps, and only the final trick settles the hand. Knocks raise the loss for everyone still in. Hit seven points and you are out.
prompts.ai: Game alias: Siwweschr M Eifel Poker. Engine: last-trick Toepen variant. Core loop: deal 4 -> four tricks with follow-suit -> knock/fold pressure -> penalties -> eliminate at 7.

scoring.winCondition: Be the last player below seven penalty points.
